title: Manner and Classification: szerint and oly módon, hogy

sections.title: Classifying by Criteria: 'szerint'
sections.content: You know *szerint* ('according to') from B1 Unit 21. After a noun it names the criterion by which things are sorted or treated: 'a fény szerint' (according to the light), 'az állapotuk szerint' (according to their condition). The noun before 'szerint' takes no case ending.

sections.title: Methodological Precision: 'oly módon, hogy'
sections.content: In scientific descriptions, 'oly módon, hogy...' or 'olyan módon, hogy...' (in such a way that / by means of...) explains the exact manner in which an investigation or intervention is carried out, often highlighting a deliberate methodological safeguard.

sections.title: Analytical Clauses of Manner and Criterion
rows: oly módon, hogy a beteg ébren maradt
in such a way that the patient remained awake
olyan módon végezték a mérést, hogy...
they conducted the measurement in such a way that...

items.spanish: A jelenségeket a fény szerint osztályozzuk.
items.english: We classify the phenomena according to the light.

items.spanish: A professzor oly módon vizsgálta a beteget, hogy közben minden részletet feljegyzett.
items.english: The professor examined the patient in such a way that he noted down every detail meanwhile.

items.spanish: A kezelést az állapot szerint módosítják.
items.english: They modify the treatment according to the condition.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Using 'oly módon, hogy' instead of simple 'úgy, hogy' immediately elevates a procedural description to formal academic Hungarian.
